questions.prompt: How many calories are in a Big Mac?
reasoning: Two patties (~500 kcal of beef), a bun (~150) and sauce plus cheese — minus a little rounding in the official tables.
A full meal with fries and a drink is roughly double.

questions.prompt: How many runners finish the London Marathon each year?
reasoning: Around 50,000–55,000 finishers stream across Tower Bridge each spring — running shoulder to shoulder for most of the 42 kilometres.

questions.prompt: How many countries are there in Africa?
reasoning: Africa has 54 fully recognised states — more than any other continent.
The world total is 195, so Africa holds over a quarter of them.
